title: Automation of Information Centres: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A, AND ANY OTHER TWO FROM SECTION B

parts.text: Describe the steps involved in library automation process.
Discuss five factors to consider when selecting a suitable software for library / Information centre automation.
Highlight five common flaws of automation plans that lead to failed system implementation.
Highlight five disadvantages for using open source software for library automation.
Discuss five functions of interlibrary loan system in an information centre
Discuss five core aspects for the rationale of automating libraries in Kenya
Discuss five critical points that one needs to look out for during system demonstration by vendors.
Describe how to conduct a cost benefit analysis for automation of an information centre
Discuss the criteria used for evaluating information systems.
Explain the major types of system maintenance.
